newsitem.title: UK: Lavendon shares gain on magazine comment.
newsitem.headline: Lavendon shares gain on magazine comment.

text.p: Shares in Lavendon Group Plc rose on Monday after positive comment in the Analyst magazine, a specialist publication, dealers said.
The stock of the power access equipment fleet operator was up 31p at 231-1/2, after rising as high as 238p -- its highest since the company's flotation last October after a placing at 140p.

The magazine said the company, which specialises in powered access platforms, was the only company devoting itself 100 percent to what was a fast growing market and that growth had if anything appeared to have accelerated since flotation.
It said Lavendon's stock market rating was cheap given likely growth of at least 25 percent though 1998.
